notes.title: Version 1.32B released
notes.notes:
Bug fixed: Switches in the Sealed Cave were not working.

Description errors were fixed: Weapon techniques were incorrectly described.

notes.title: Version 1.32A released.
notes.notes:
Fixed a setting error that prevented Belial from joining the party during a sub-event.
Added a support character during the white rat sub-event.

notes.title: Version 1.32 released
notes.notes:
Fixed missing English translations in some shops.
Fixed an issue where the left hand symbol was displayed as the right hand when dual-wielding.
Added new items to Gabriel's Room and the Stellar Apartments.
Added icons to the descriptions of status recovery items.

Enter the warehouse next to Mikael's room.
The items are in the grey barrels.
Select a factor from the menu and equip your character!

notes.title: 1.21 Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a fatal bug that caused Sephira to be unusable after using Beauty Salon.
- Fixed a settings error where the building to the right of Moonlight Heaven was connected to the weapon shop in Primeval Heaven.
- Other battle balance adjustments.

notes.title: Ver1.20 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638251/062d02525588bb98df48c7c85acb7f90281d5612.png[/img]
The first of six branching main stories has been added to the second half of Episode 2.
Two sub-events have been added.

The six branching main storylines will be played in no particular order in the final version, but in this update only the Mercury Heaven Metatron route has been unlocked.

notes.title: 1.11A
notes.notes:
Further corrections.

Additions and corrections since 1.10.
- Added the beginning of Episode 2 of the main scenario.
- Added 2 sub-scenarios.
- Changed Hades Ring's resistance from incapacitation to instant death and sentence.
- Increased Hades Ring and Medusa Ring's resistance from 30% to 40%.
- Changed Michael Sword from "Normal attack damage increases based on the wielder's level" to "Weapon attack power is set by Michael's level". Attack power can now be benefited from special skills as well.
- Added "Accuracy" factor.
1.11 corrections.
- Fixed a problem where the FPS was dropping to around 40-50 on some maps by splitting the maps.
1.11A corrections.
- Fixed a place where a change in the map itself required a change to the movement location, but one place was missed.
Fixed a bug where FPS was not displayed on some maps.
